from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,socket,sqlite3,sys,tarfile,time
p=Path('/home/dflanag3/src/spacial_desktop/spatial-os-luna-handoff');assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]=='sb16'
os.umask(0o077);sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'tests/core'),str(p/'build/python'),str(p)]
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],str(p/'build/identityd')]
from test_identity_tls import TlsFixture
import issuer_pb2 as pb
fixture=TlsFixture();fixture.setUp();folder=p/'local/m01-session-crosshost';folder.mkdir()
try:
 fixture.config.idle_timeout_ms=10000
 proc=fixture.launch('0.0.0.0');peer=fixture.connect()
 changed=fixture.execute(peer,fixture.challenge(peer,fixture.operation(pb.APPROVE_ALWAYS,profile='empty-v1')))
 assert changed.policy.policy.mode==pb.APPROVE_ALWAYS;peer.close()
 metadata={'host':'sb16','port':fixture.port,'issuer_id':fixture.info.issuer_id.hex(),'issuer_public_key':fixture.info.public_key.hex()}
 meta=fixture.root/'connection.json';meta.write_text(json.dumps(metadata))
 with tarfile.open(folder/'fixture.tar','w') as archive:
  for file in [meta,fixture.server_cert,fixture.service_cert,fixture.service_key]:archive.add(file,arcname=file.name,recursive=False)
 print('READY',flush=True);deadline=time.monotonic()+180;revoked=False
 while not (folder/'stop').exists():
  assert proc.poll() is None
  if not revoked and (folder/'revoke').exists():
   with sqlite3.connect(f'file:{fixture.state}/identity.db?mode=ro',uri=True) as db:
    rows=list(db.execute('SELECT id FROM credential'))
   assert len(rows)==1
   peer=fixture.connect()
   operation=pb.IssuerOperation(identity_revoke=pb.IdentityRevoke(target=pb.IdentityReference(kind=pb.CREDENTIAL_TARGET,id=rows[0][0]),expected_security_revision=0,reason='cross-host world fixture'))
   result=fixture.execute(peer,fixture.challenge(peer,operation));assert result.identity_status.credential_revoked
   peer.close();revoked=True
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Cross-host server expired')
  time.sleep(.05)
 assert revoked
 record={'issuer_host':'sb16','world_host':'sb16-2','fixture_only':True,'status':'passed',
         'identityd_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'build/identityd').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
         'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'tests/core/test_world_identity.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 (folder/'server.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
finally:
 fixture.doCleanups();(folder/'fixture.tar').unlink(missing_ok=True)
fixture_cleanup: Temporary keys, certificates, issuer database, and transfer archives removed.
